title: Domain Registrations Feature Availability: Privacy, Locks and DNSSEC
content:
# Domain Registrations — Feature Availability: Privacy, Locks and DNSSEC

Product catalogue feature matrix for Domain Registrations.

| TLD product | WHOIS privacy available | Privacy switched on automatically at registration or transfer-in | Registry lock can be ordered | Business days to release a registry lock | Registrar transfer lock on by default | DNSSEC on Harborline DNS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | No | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | Yes |
| .ca Domain Registration | No | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | Yes |
| .com Domain Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| .org Domain Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| .net Domain Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| .co Domain Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| .io Domain Registration | Yes | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | Yes |

## Notes

- Release business days are counted Monday to Friday, US federal holidays excluded, from the registrant's authorised request.
- Registry lock is orderable on .com, .org, .net and .co Domain Registrations only; on .us, .ca and .io the release column reads 0 because the service does not exist there.
- DNSSEC signing can be enabled on Harborline DNS for every TLD product.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a hypothetical .co Domain Registration whose registrant makes an authorised release request on a Monday with no US federal holiday in that week, 3 business days run Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday; for a .com Domain Registration the same request needs 2 business days.
